releases.notes:
AutoDrop v1.4.0 release

Changes in this version:
- Added stationary-only humanizer mode
- New setting: /dropitem settings humanizer <true|false>
- New setting: /dropitem settings humanizer_delay <ms>
- Humanizer now queues items while moving and drops stack-by-stack only when stationary
- Improved movement detection to treat W/A/S/D key presses as active movement (prevents false stationary drops during counter-input)

Existing features retained:
- Directional drop options (front/back/left/right)
- Full stack toggle and timing modes
- Item list management with command suggestions

Artifact:
- autodrop-1.4.0.jar

releases.notes:
AutoDrop Mod for Minecraft 1.21.x - Automatically drop unwanted items

**Features**

- Auto-drop items when picked up based on configurable list
- Command-based configuration with tab-completion
- Drop direction control (front/back/left/right)
- Drop timing options (immediate/next tick/delayed)
- Full stack or single item dropping
- Persistent JSON configuration
- 2-second cooldown to prevent re-pickup

**Commands**

- `/dropitem mode on|off` - Enable/disable auto-drop
- `/dropitem items [item_ids...]` - Add/remove items from drop list
- `/dropitem clear` - Clear drop list
- `/dropitem settings timing <mode>` - Set drop timing
- `/dropitem settings fullstack <true|false>` - Toggle full stack drops (Default: true)
- `/dropitem settings direction <front|back|left|right>` - Set drop direction

**Installation**

1. Install Fabric Loader for Minecraft 1.21.x
2. Install Fabric API
3. Place autodrop-1.3.0.jar in your mods folder
4. Launch game and use `/dropitem` commands

**Compatibility**

- Minecraft 1.21.x (tested on 1.21.10)
- Fabric Loader 0.16.5+
- Fabric API required
- Java 21+
- Works with Wurst Client, Baritone, and other client mods

**Configuration**

Settings saved to `.minecraft/config/autodrop.json`
